priority_hypothesis.focus: Hai bài toán về phân số

priority_hypothesis.focus: Chu vi và diện tích một số tứ giác đã học
priority_hypothesis.reason: Multi-step geometric measurement, unit discipline and real-context interpretation are better evidenced by full written work than by recognition-only items.

priority_hypothesis.focus: Đoạn thẳng, trung điểm, góc, số đo và phân loại góc
priority_hypothesis.reason: Paper-based drawing/measurement/representation and short geometry reasoning are poorly represented by final-answer-only interaction; prioritize one or more structurally distinct anchors rather than one per lesson.

priority_hypothesis.focus: Bảng/biểu đồ và nhận xét dữ liệu
priority_hypothesis.reason: High written value, but two already-approved CT21 items may be reusable if S1 confirms genuine Grade-6 placement. Do not author duplicates before reuse review.

priority_hypothesis.focus: Kết quả có thể và sự kiện
priority_hypothesis.reason: Listing outcomes and explaining event language can benefit from written reasoning, but the lesson is conceptually smaller and should follow the higher-value modelling/geometry anchors.
A useful written anchor would emphasize choosing an appropriate approximation and explaining why; routine rounding itself is already covered interactively.

priority_hypothesis.focus: Phân số bằng nhau, so sánh và hỗn số dương
priority_hypothesis.reason: Written representation and justification can add value, but much of the procedural work is already well suited to Learn/Micro/Practice.

defer_without_new_evidence.reason: Current Learn/Micro/Practice evidence already covers mainly routine, recognition or direct-execution structures. Do not add Written items merely to fill every NONE row.
